about.title: About Me
about.description: Senior Web Engineer with 6 years of experience building high-performance frontend architectures, AI-integrated workflows, restaurant SaaS, and international commerce solutions using React, Node.js, and GraphQL.

experience.companyPeriod: Jan 2025 - Present · A Booking Holdings company

responsibilities: Won 1st prize in OpenTable's 2026 hackathon, placing first among approximately 45 teams worldwide.
Earned 2nd prize in OpenTable's 2025 hackathon; the idea was selected for a production bonus and released to production a few months later.
Collaborated remotely with a global product and engineering team to build AI-assisted restaurant onboarding that reduced merchant setup work.
Designed a multi-location dashboard for enterprise restaurant metrics and account management.
Improved onboarding conversion by fixing routing, validation, and error-handling issues.
Expanded E2E and integration coverage across core, AI, payment, and onboarding flows.
Led a zero-downtime React migration and created reusable UI components.
Modernized Node.js and React apps and built self-service payment tools that reduced manual operations.
Led frontend development for UNIQLO's global commerce platform with React and GraphQL, serving 60M+ active users across Japan, the US, European markets, and select Asian markets.
Improved a Node.js/Express BFF that connected more than 20 microservices.
Built country configuration tooling for localization and multi-brand expansion.
Integrated Google Wallet with 3DS in 26 countries, increasing checkout conversion by 10%.
Ran Firebase experiments on cart recommendations and shipped the strongest variants.
Built a drag-and-drop PWA email builder with React and PostgreSQL.
Developed a UNIQLO referral feature that contributed to 800K+ customer growth in the US and Japan.
Created a React/GraphQL proof of concept for mapping API calls and diagnosing errors.
Mentored junior engineers in frontend architecture and platform practices.

projects.name: Wizard's Chess (PWA)
projects.description: An experimental multiplayer 3D chess world that turns unusual interaction ideas into a polished real-time browser experience.
details: Implemented immersive 3D rendering and game state management using React Three Fiber and Three.js.
Integrated peer-to-peer video communication using WebRTC and Firebase for real-time multiplayer engagement.
